## Why This Is Asked
Assesses zero-trust cross-account design, ABAC, and incident containment.

## Key Concepts
- ABAC with OIDC and STS AssumeRole
- Tenant-scoped KMS keys with rotation
- Lake Formation permissions per tenant
- Cross-account trust, PrivateLink

```pseudo
Version: 2012-10-17

    Condition:
      StringEquals:

```
